method: Targeted production-city stress test. Native requestAnimationFrame intervals are recorded with a minimal callback; detailed physics/renderer/heap snapshots occur outside timing windows. Direct civilian.damage is an explicitly authorized load fixture, not actual combat input. The existing nearest 32 civilians are selected once; no NPC positions, body velocities, masses, world time, or sleep states are directly changed. Only the observation player/camera is initially placed near the core intersection.
limitations: One fixed camera and one hardware/browser run; no blanket performance or visual-quality claim.
Heap metrics are Chromium estimates when available.
The 24- and 32-death windows contain initial motion; the final window starts twenty seconds after the second fixture batch.
Shot-direction initialization is the unmodified production gun-death behavior.
